checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anal fin similar to second dorsal.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The anal fin is also set very far back, opposite the rear dorsal fin, which contradicts the barracouta anatomy where the anal fin is more central.
The caudal fin appears forked, consistent with many pelagic fish including barracouta.
